$comment: Content of the README pictures. Render with sh1ft-w.github.io/theme/v1/readme-images (node render.mjs <this repo>).

title.name: FLODE
title.sub: Automations and scripts as a flow you can read, test and understand. Edited with Home Assistant's own editors, saved as plain YAML.

new.title: Top to bottom
new.text: Every flow runs left to right or top to bottom. The direction is saved with the flow.

new.title: Branches as cards
new.text: Choose and If-then draw each branch as cards, nested as deep as you like. In YAML it stays a plain choose or if.

new.title: Run this card
new.text: Runs one step for real in Home Assistant, without everything after it. Inside branches too.

new.title: Made for fingers
new.text: Press and hold opens a card's menu on touch screens, on the iPhone too.

made.title: Home Assistant's editors
made.text: Every step opens in Home Assistant's own editor, with the same forms, pickers and dialogs as in Settings.

made.title: Your icons, language, theme
made.text: Cards show the entity's own icon with its live state. Light or dark, on desktop, tablet and phone.

made.title: Plain YAML, both ways
made.text: Open any automation, change it visually, save it back. It stays editable in Home Assistant's own editor.

made.title: Home Assistant's table
made.text: The start page is the same table as under Settings: filters, grouping, labels and bulk actions.

else.title: Scripts, too
else.text: With fields, a run button that asks for them, and Run from here for any step.

else.title: Template workshop
else.text: Jinja rendered live by Home Assistant, with the result type and the variables of a real run.

else.title: Commands and shortcuts
else.text: Everything in one search, right-click menus, copy, paste, duplicate, and an overview on ?.

else.title: Tabs and minimap
else.text: Several flows open at once, each with its own undo. A minimap for big ones, tidy up in one click.

else.title: Import, export, merge
else.text: Paste YAML, save as copy, FLODE files, and merge several automations into one.

else.title: Careful with your data
else.text: Warns when it cannot read part of an automation, keeps unknown fields as written, opens blueprints read-only.

else.title: Readable zoomed out
else.text: Below 60 percent the cards show icon, title and one line in large type; below 35 percent just the icon.

else.title: On the go
else.text: On a phone the tools move into a swipeable strip and the editor slides up as a sheet.
